why: Two parts of the spec disagree on CO-S05: the dimension definition (line 1498) requires 'was not cancelled', from the CO-S11 rejection row (line 98), but CO-01 (line 62), its failure row (line 92) and the CO-S05 Unambiguity note (line 395) require 'has shipped and cannot be cancelled'. A literal judge could fail an agent that keeps CO-01. Minor, but real.
